rows.quoted_evidence: We enclose the signed Bid Securing Declaration in the prescribed form.
We are a Class-I local supplier; the offered instrument has 62% local content, as stated in our self-certificate.
The OEM authorisation for the offered spectrophotometer model is attached as Annex B.
We completed two supply orders of UV-Visible spectrophotometers to Government laboratories in the last three years.
We offer a three-year comprehensive onsite warranty.
We will provide two days of onsite operator training after installation.
The offered instrument has a wavelength accuracy of 0.5 nm.
A signed Bid Securing Declaration is submitted with this bid.
We are a Class-II local supplier: local content in the offered instrument is 34%, as per the enclosed self-certificate.
We attach the manufacturer's authorisation for the quoted spectrophotometer model.
Three similar orders of UV-Visible spectrophotometers to academic institutions were completed in the last three years.
Onsite training for operators: two days after installation.
Wavelength accuracy of the quoted model is 0.3 nm.
The offered instrument is imported and its local content is 12%, so we are a non-local supplier.
OEM authorisation for the offered spectrophotometers is enclosed.

notes: B3 declares itself a non-local supplier (local content 12%, below the 20% Class-II threshold), so mandatory M2 (Class-I or Class-II local supplier as per the PPP-MII Order) fails and B3 is non-responsive; its scored rows are not evaluated even though its answers look strong, and its price is recorded only. B1 is Class-I (62%, at least 50%) and B2 is Class-II (34%, at least 20% but below 50%). Any purchase preference to Class-I suppliers is a financial-stage matter and is not applied here. Draft ranking for the committee; not an award.
